items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: Was Al Celley the manager then? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.

ctx.x: Paul Gonsalves was always drawing on his salary, and Paul Gonsalves paid the most exorbitant rates of interest to Al Celley you ever heard of. Celley used to ask me to sign double receipts when he paid me -- two receipts; that meant that Celley had accounted for twice as much money as he paid out.

I never will understand about Celley. He always got all the money in his pocket. Like we'd play a dance tonight and he'd get the money and he'd put it in his pocket. I give this man -- Duke Ellington won $50, the
other man would win so and so, Duke Ellington won over $40, and he'd give all that money to everybody, but he didn't keep an account of it.
